title: Do you have psychic abilities?
content: I would like to know if anyone in this sub has noticed they are either: precognitive (able to see things before they happen), an empath(able to feel the emotions of others without knowing or speaking to them), telepathic(able to read the thoughts of others or receive or send messages via thoughts), clairvoyant (experience extrasensory perceptions), (additional senses), medium (able to communicate with entities).
